# Hope Trust Vellore

> Hope Trust is a registered charitable trust in Katpadi, Vellore, Tamil Nadu. It supports people and families through community medical assistance, education support, family welfare and volunteer-led outreach.

Canonical website: https://hopetrustvellore.in

## Organisation identity

- Public name: Hope Trust Vellore
- Legal account name: HOPE TRUST
- Registration number: B4/28/2026
- Established: 2026
- President: Dr. Lavanya Jayakumar, physiotherapist and rehabilitation specialist
- Primary service area: Katpadi, Vellore and nearby communities in Tamil Nadu, India
- Languages available for contact: English and Tamil

## Programme areas

- Community medical camps and health awareness
- Physiotherapy and rehabilitation guidance
- Assistance with essential diagnostics, medicines and treatment needs
- School-fee, uniform and learning-material support
- Tuition, mentoring and practical skill development
- Women and elder-care outreach
- Essential supplies and coordinated family relief
- Volunteer opportunities in healthcare, education, outreach, logistics and administration

## Donations

Hope Trust accepts donations in Indian rupees by direct bank transfer. Current verified transfer instructions, beneficiary checks and receipt guidance are published on the donation page:

- https://hopetrustvellore.in/donate

Donors should confirm that their bank displays the beneficiary name HOPE TRUST before transferring. They should never share an OTP, PIN or banking password. After a transfer, donors can send their transaction reference to the Hope Trust team for verification and receipt assistance.
